chunk_map.heading: On your own product, you are the check

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8: "Either the agent invented a fact, or your team never wrote that one down." closest: 'that one' resolves to 'a fact' in the same sentence; 'the draft' (L6) resolves to the press release drafted at L4; 'it hasn't got' (L8) = the agent. Harm (unresolved referent) absent.

rules_evaluated.na_reason: no pointer to another file or deck position

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw' backward reference

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L6-8: the slide carries a full claim (draft is a claim; your knowledge is the second read; a mismatch is worth a look), not a wait-state.
L1 header 'On your own product, you are the check' vs L8 'You hold what it hasn't got: you know this product': the body delivers the header's claim literally.

L6: 'as a claim about your product, not a verdict' is a single contrast, not a 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' chain; no triples, superlatives, number+retraction, noun stacks or empty verb legs (grep em dash/banned words CLEAN in view).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: view greps banned_words/ritual_ceremony/leverage CLEAN; L4-8 use press release, draft, agent, product: ordinary engineer-room words; no surface-as-noun, firing, beat, mood.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: slide file included by manifest lectures; presence is a renderer concern, no phase-less section

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers; check-slide-numbering.js --file -> OK, exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/you-are-the-check.md -> OK, no page-geometry pointers, exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links (view signals has_urls false)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/you-are-the-check.md -> 1 slide, oversized: 0, exit 0 (9 body lines, 3 paragraphs)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 'On your own product, you are the check' is a declarative claim on a lecture slide, which is the required lecture grammar.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6 'So read the draft as a claim about your product, not a verdict.' closest to a kicker but it is the slide's actionable instruction, not a restatement of the header; no doctrine restatement or design commentary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no header rename visible against bullets: git log shows only authoring commits; slide body matches header

notes: Single-slide file; one chunk. Accept-note: maintainer STATUS line only (no rule-specific accept).
